'''Iain''' was a member of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Security Forces]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="E1:IG" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="EAWGG">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> during the last [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Iain was in active service by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], when Naboo was [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|droid armies]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Iain wore a [[Color/Legends|red]] combat [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] labeled with their name in [[Futhork/Legends|Futhork]],<ref name="E1:IG" /> the informal handwritten [[Writing/Legends|alphabet]] of the [[Naboo (language)|Naboo]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|299|Futhork}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Iain_helmet.png|150px|thumb|Iain's helmet (with the name in Futhork)]]
A helmet labeled "Iain" in Futhork was shown amongst various props in a gallery of ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide]]'', an interactive CD-ROM produced following the release of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] in [[1999]].<ref name="E1:IG" /> However, the inscription on the helmet remained undeciphered for years, since the mapping of the Futhork alphabet was not officially revealed until [[2008]], with the release of the reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" />

Although the ''Insider's Guide'' describes the prop as a helmet of the Royal Security Forces,<ref name="E1:IG" /> it has in fact the shape of an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer's]] helmet&mdash;like the one worn by [[Simon Jabesq]].<ref name="E1VG">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The character of Iain shares a name with [[Iain McCaig]], who worked as a conceptual designer on ''The Phantom Menace''.<ref name="TT1">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/profile/f20011019/index.html|text=Drawing Attention: Iain McCaig}}</ref>

This present article assumes that such marked Naboo helmets correspond to the wearers' names, following the example of Simon Jabesq, whose helmet reads "Simon" when using the transliteration table from ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia''.<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="E1VG" />
